title: CallingGraph Unfolding for AI Coding — From Design-Time Structural Planning to Runtime Validation and Certification
description: CallingGraph Unfolding for AI Coding (CGU) studies how a folded functional CallingGraph can be selectively unfolded into localized structural possibilities for design-time planning, AI coding execution, runtime validation, and evidence-bounded certification. CGU v1.0 focuses strictly on Function-only CallingGraph structure. It introduces CallingGraph Folding, Trigger-Localized Unfolding, Design-Time CallingGraphs, Structural Wargaming, Realized CallingGraphs, the Unfolding Gap, Differential Unfolding, confidence-based certification, and the CallingGraph as an AI Coding Structural Control Plane. The framework moves CallingGraph from a passive post-coding analysis artifact toward an operational structural object participating across the lifecycle: Design → Unfold → Simulate → Dispatch → Code → Fold → Compare → Certify → Learn.
notes: CGU v1.0 deliberately restricts its formal scope to Function-only CallingGraph structure. Condition/Context, Runtime State, Policy/Projection, and richer Calling Structural Space models are reserved for future research.
